notes.title: v 1.13 patch
notes.content:
This Update add small improvements to the game and fix some bugs :

[list]
[*] The game now saves configuration options, for example if you set the language to french, it will stay to french the next time you open the game.
[*]Saving have been improved, You no longer loose gold when you die.'
[*]The troll ennemy is now more predictable in his attack, this give you some time to react...
[*]You have to press down arrow + space to fall from platforms now, so you no longer have to worry about falling into lava by mistake.
[*]The gobelin merchand is more fair and gives you some time to react when angry.
[*]Added portal menu transition at the end boss.
[*]Ennemies can no longuer kill you while you are talking to the merchand or in dialog state. 
[*]Infinite gold bug fix on the mantis Boss (you could have infinite gold if you spammed the boss after his death ːsteammockingː)
[*]some small graphics improvements on the big coins, the castle and other maps.
[*]subtle decrease of music in the dialogs
[/list]

I think this update will make the game a bit more easier , and will remove the frustration some players had. Overall this update will make the game more fun !

If you have any questions and comments let me know !

Thank you everyone !

notes.title: Wizcave Update 1.12
notes.content:
Hi, I am still working on Wizcave ! 

Since the launch in august, I decided to make a new update to fix some issues the game had, but also add new content.

This update features :
[list]
[*] 2 New languages (Russian and Chinease).
[*] New Troll Ennemy.
[*] New Elevator Map.
[*] New dialogs.
[*] New Skills (Lightning Bolt) and prolonge staff.
[*] New gold pieces.
[*] Added stair animation.
[*] Support for skipping menu cinematics.
[/list]

I hope you will have fun playing this new update. Please share the word to your friends to help me promote this game. 

Also feel free to make videos / Stream about my game if you want.  Anything that can promote the game is fine.

Thank you again for you support !
